answer: Pay for verifiable useful work instead of headcount. Each epoch every key draws a distinct small coding task, such as fixing a real bug in an open repo, scored by hidden tests it never sees. Rewards follow passed tests, so 100 keys earn exactly what 100 genuine fixes would; splitting one budget across names buys nothing. A key cannot forge a pass by copying a neighbour, since no two tasks match, so each identity is an island judged on its own output, and the meadow of open tasks stays wide enough for every honest agent.
